label: English
title: Your raid, on your second monitor.
pitchLead: Rastro is a live map of your raid for your second monitor.
pitchRest: Take a screenshot in game and your position appears, with the way to every extract. Your quests, your hideout, the bosses and your squad, on the same screen, without alt-tabbing.
pitch2: It never touches the game: it only reads files Tarkov already writes to your disk. Free, open source, made by players for players.
sub: Free and open source · No installer · No account · Nothing to configure
heroAlt: Customs in raid: your position, a raid plan with its route, the bosses and the time left.
fileBody: Every time Tarkov saves a screenshot, the game writes your position into the file name. Rastro reads that name. It doesn't open the image, touch the game, read its memory or watch its network traffic.
logs: Optionally, it also reads the text logs the game writes, to know which map you're on and when a raid starts.
tiles: Play as a squad
Everyone on the same map, encrypted PC to PC. No server, no account.
Quests that follow the game
Ticked off from the game logs, with every open objective on the map.
Hideout
What each next level needs, and which items not to sell.
Bosses on the map
Where each boss can spawn and the chance it's there, PvP and PvE.
Raid clock
Time left, Tarkov time on both sides and the armored train window.
Prices and ammo
Flea and trader prices, keys and every round, searched offline.
steps: **Download** `Rastro-windows-x64.exe` and run it. There's nothing to install.
**Follow the short setup.** It finds your screenshots folder and downloads the maps from tarkov.dev.
**Take a screenshot in game.** Your arrow appears on the map.
lean: Small and light
A native app written in Rust. One .exe, no installer, and it barely uses CPU.
Open source
MIT license. Every release is built from the public code by GitHub Actions.
Private
No account, no ads, no telemetry. It only listens on your own PC.
Squad without servers
Friends connect PC to PC, encrypted end to end.
Works offline
Maps, quests and prices are downloaded once and searched on your PC.
16 languages
The same languages tarkov.dev supports, for the app and its data.
communityTitle: From the community, for the community
communityBody: Rastro is free and will stay free: no ads, no premium tier, no catch. What comes next is decided by the players who use it, through their ideas, bug reports and translations.
credit: Maps, quests and prices come from tarkov.dev, the community project that makes tools like this possible.
mapsCredit: Map imagery by the tarkov.dev contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
footer: Escape from Tarkov is a trademark of Battlestate Games. Rastro is not affiliated with or endorsed by Battlestate Games or tarkov.dev.
never: Open, edit or upload your screenshots
Touch the game or its process
featuresLead: Everything you'd alt-tab for, on one screen.

Убежище

Боссы на карте

Часы рейда
Оставшееся время, время в Таркове с обеих сторон и окно бронепоезда.
Цены и патроны
Цены барахолки и торговцев, ключи и все патроны, без интернета.

pitch2: 它从不触碰游戏：只读取塔科夫本来就写入磁盘的文件。免费、开源，由玩家为玩家打造。
sub: 免费开源 · 无需安装 · 无需账号 · 无需配置
heroAlt: 海关战局中：你的位置、带路线的战局计划、首领和剩余时间。
fileBody: 塔科夫每次保存截图时，游戏都会把你的位置写进文件名。Rastro 只读取这个文件名。它不打开图片，不触碰游戏，不读取游戏内存，也不监听网络流量。
logs: 你也可以选择让它读取游戏写入的文本日志，以便知道你在哪张地图、战局何时开始。
tiles: 小队一起玩
所有人在同一张地图上，PC 到 PC 端到端加密。无需服务器和账号。
跟随游戏的任务
根据游戏日志自动勾选，每个未完成目标都显示在地图上。
藏身处
每个设施下一级需要什么，以及哪些物品不能卖。
地图上的首领
每个首领可能出现的位置和概率，区分 PvP 与 PvE。
战局时钟
剩余时间、两侧的塔科夫时间和装甲列车的时间窗口。
价格与弹药
跳蚤市场和商人价格、钥匙和所有弹药，离线可查。
steps: **下载** `Rastro-windows-x64.exe` 并运行，无需安装。
**完成简短设置。** 它会找到你的截图文件夹，并从 tarkov.dev 下载地图。
**在游戏里截图。** 你的箭头就会出现在地图上。
lean: 小巧轻量
用 Rust 编写的原生应用。只有一个 .exe，无需安装，几乎不占 CPU。
开源
MIT 许可证。每个版本都由 GitHub Actions 从公开代码构建。
注重隐私
无需账号，没有广告，没有遥测。只在你自己的电脑上监听。
无服务器的小队
好友之间 PC 到 PC 直连，端到端加密。
离线可用
地图、任务和价格只需下载一次，在你的电脑上即可搜索。
16 种语言
与 tarkov.dev 相同的语言，应用和数据都支持。
communityBody: Rastro 免费，并将一直免费：没有广告，没有高级版，没有套路。接下来做什么，由使用它的玩家通过想法、错误报告和翻译来决定。
credit: 地图、任务和价格数据来自 tarkov.dev，正是这个社区项目让此类工具成为可能。
mapsCredit: 地图图像由 tarkov.dev 贡献者提供，CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
footer: Escape from Tarkov 是 Battlestate Games 的商标。Rastro 与 Battlestate Games 或 tarkov.dev 无关，也未获其认可。
never: 打开、修改或上传你的截图
featuresLead: 原本需要 Alt+Tab 才能看的东西，都在一块屏幕上。
